examples.name: Default
examples.summary: A collection shown as cards: the `header` slot names each card and the default slot lays out its fields. Four columns in a wide container, then three, two and one as it narrows (container queries, not the viewport).

examples.name: Selectable
examples.summary: Bound to `useCollection` with multi selection: each card gets a checkbox named by its header, a visible Select all items sits above the cards, and the selection survives paging.

examples.name: SingleSelection
examples.summary: `selection-mode="single"` with `v-model:selected-keys`: one radio per card named by its header, and no Select all.

examples.name: Loading
examples.summary: `loading` shows placeholder cards and sets `aria-busy` while the items load.

examples.name: Empty
examples.summary: With no items the default empty state shows; the `empty` slot replaces it with resource copy and a create action.
